projectDescription: An open-source PowerShell script that automates the setup of a GPU-powered Windows cloud workstation on AWS or Azure for gaming and creative work.
keyFeatures: Automated GPU driver installation and configuration
Streaming technology selection (Sunshine, Parsec, Amazon DCV)
Windows Server configuration for cloud workstation use
Tailscale VPN integration for secure remote access
AWS cost optimization via Lambda + cold storage automation
Virtual display driver (VDD) setup for Sunshine/Parsec
Microsoft Store installation on Windows Server
